Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Rajnesh Oswal, Judge
 Order

. The present petition has been filed by the petitioner for quashing FIR No. 96/2023 dated 13.05.2023, registered with the Police Station Baramulla, for commission of offences under Sections 376, 342 & 506 IPC, registered at the instance of respondent no. 5.
It is stated that the respondent no. 5, has lodged the FIR against the petitioner just to harass him and he has been filing several complaints against him.
In the complaint filed before police station Rajbagh Srinagar, the respondent no. 5, had claimed herself to be the wife of the petitioner.
He further submits that the respondent no. 5 cannot take different pleas in different proceedings and that no date, place of occurrence has been mentioned in the FIR.
2. Notice shall go to respondent no. 5 only.
3. Requisites for service within one week.

4. Mr Jahangir Dar, learned GA on behalf of respondents no. 1 to 4 submits that he has received Shoiab Lone vs Union Territory Of J & K & Ors on 22 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/58181069/

Mr Jahangir Dar, further submits that the respondent no. 5 was repeatedly requested to appear for recording of her statement, but she did not turn up.
He further seeks time to file detailed response.
He may do so by or before next date of hearing 5.
6. In the meanwhile, subject to objections and till next date of hearing before the Bench, the investigation shall stay except to the extent of the recording of the statement of the prosecutrix.
